persisted_module: TravelDecisions required only in this ruleset; omitted and rejected elsewhere; no implicit upgrade

rules.redirect: Apply at current edge endpoint; sea at next port. Keep traveled prefix unchanged. One pending decision per actor.
rules.cancel: Only sea leg waiting, now strictly before departure. Immediate stop at the same port AtSite; then new trip permitted.
rules.shared_time: WorldSession clock and event boundaries; condition updates, decision apply, progress, common courier and completion handling.
rules.agency: Only player acting on own running trip with valid Move grant. No remote lord teleportation or interception.
rules.idempotency: Same request returns AlreadyAccepted, changed content conflicts. Atomic rollback, unique business effect, expected revision checked.

video.capture: Actual Godot Movie Maker frames; scripted game actions, no native input
video.scope: Next-node personal redirection, port cancellation before departure, exact restoration and continuation

limitations: Road-side instant U-turn and sea stop not implemented
Weather, capacity, fares, port access rights and service cancellations not implemented
Coarse land/sea route network inherited; no historical ferry timetable or port scenery claim
Old shared-source bindings invalidated pending re-verification
next: Road closures / service suspension interaction with pending decisions and port waits; then regional people, factions and missions
